title: Thinking of herself as a singer; talent in the family
summary: She always thought of herself as a singer, taught by teachers and a cousin, and says musical talent is natural in her family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
